scripts.typecheck: pnpm -r typecheck && tsc -p deploy/tsconfig.json && tsc -p api/tsconfig.json

RELAY_DATABASE_URL.description: Your Turso/libSQL database URL. A remote database is required; container disks are temporary.

RELAY_DATABASE_AUTH_TOKEN.description: Read/write auth token for your database.

RELAY_TOKEN_HASH_KEY.description: Generate a 32-byte base64 key with openssl rand -base64 32.

RELAY_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Generate a separate 32-byte base64 key with openssl rand -base64 32. Keep it stable across deployments.

RELAY_CLI_TOKEN.description: A random bootstrap token starting with relay_cli_. See the cloud deployment guide.

APNS_KEY_ID.description: The key ID for your Apple push signing key.

APNS_PRIVATE_KEY.description: The contents of your APNs .p8 key. Literal \n sequences are accepted.

APNS_BUNDLE_ID.description: The bundle ID of your signed Relay iPhone app.
